posts.summary:
General Dynamics Information Technology, Inc. received a task order under the GSA Alliant 2 contract vehicle from the General Services Administration's Federal Acquisition Service. The award, signed on November 13, 2026, supports network support services and computer systems design work. The task order carries an initial obligation of approximately $3.8 million against a ceiling of roughly $371.4 million and runs through November 15, 2027.

The work involves modernization efforts for an enterprise test network and was procured through full and open competition using commercial procedures. This task order was released publicly on November 20, 2026.

The Department of State awarded New Tech Solutions, Inc. an indefinite delivery vehicle for computer-related services with a ceiling value of $9.75 million. The agreement, signed on September 24, 2026, provides access to business application software licensing and related IT services.

The vehicle became publicly available in November 2026 and is effective from late September 2026. It enables the department to procure software and associated technical support on an as-needed basis throughout the period of the agreement.
